payload.campaign: uuid — the campaign the media is added to
payload.kind: 'battlemap' | 'illustration' — a battlemap arrives with its default grid, an illustration with none
payload.title: string — not blank
payload.file: string — the local path the DM chose; no file is copied. Optional, '' when none
payload.width: integer ≥ 0 — the image's width in pixels; optional, 0 when unknown
payload.height: integer ≥ 0 — the image's height in pixels; optional, 0 when unknown
payload.place: uuid | null — optional: a « lieu » of the same campaign (media-place-is-lieu)
